messages:
Alex Nguyen: quick heads-up — we need to reforecast the Q2 OKR for Reduce-Latency. Two enterprise customers asked for ~50% p99 reduction by EoQ. engineering estimates add ~8 GPUs + caching work -> ~\"$30k/mo\". can product leadership weigh in on scope tradeoffs?
Mia Chen: can you share impact on other Q2 commitments? which parts are incremental vs replacing planned work?
Alex Nguyen: main overlap is Telemetry v2 (workstream B). options: 1) shift Telemetry v2 out and reallocate cycles, 2) scope latency work to caching+quantization (smaller) now and defer kernel rewrite, or 3) ask customers to accept phased SLA.
Jordan Patel: quick eng estimate: full kernel changes = 6 wks core team + risky regression window. caching+quant = ~3 wks with one backend engineer + 2 infra sprints. cost delta ~ $25–35k/mo depending on reserved vs burst.
Sam Ortiz: UX note — stricter p99 SLA may require changes to error-handling pages and docs. docs/console work ~1 sprint.
Priya Rao: revenue context: Customer A = $1.2M ARR, renewal in 5 months; Customer B = $180k ARR upsell opportunity. probability-weighted impact makes this material to ARR outlook.
Mia Chen: ok. product asks: 1) do we have an MVP scope that preserves customer SLA but minimizes cross-OKR disruption? 2) what rollback/fallback plan if regressions hit?
Jordan Patel: MVP = caching + KV prefetch + 8-bit quantize profile for the model (no kernel rewrite). fallback = automatic routing to previous model variant + throttling. canary in us-west first.
Alex Nguyen: propose we shift Telemetry v2 out of Q2 (move to Q3), adopt Jordan's MVP, and increase infra spend by $30k/mo funded out of Q2 contingency. decision needed from product leads by EoD tomorrow so we can order capacity.
Priya Rao: finance note — we have ~ $120k contingency left in Q2. approving this would use ~25% of that. finance ok on principle if we get confirmation of customer contract acceleration (need signed intent).
Mia Chen: I'm tentatively +1 on shifting Telemetry and doing MVP if Jordan owns rollout plan + rollback playbook. Alex, get signed LOI or escalation from AE for Customer A before we commit spend.
Alex Nguyen: will ping @Ben (AE) and ask for LOI today. I'll also open a short runbook doc and link it here.
DeployBot: calendar: "Latency scope review / capacity sign-off" created for 2024-11-28 16:00 UTC.
Jordan Patel: action items I can take: 1) draft rollout + canary plan (due in 24h), 2) infra order estimate + cost options reserved vs burst (24h).
Sam Ortiz: I'll scope console + docs changes, 3-day workblock, will sync with Jordan on canary UX.
Alex Nguyen: summary & decisions: - Telemetry v2 -> move to Q3 - Adopt MVP (caching + quant + 8 GPUs reserved initially) - Finance approves conditional on LOI from AE - Jordan to produce rollout + rollback plan in 24h - Mia to confirm final approval after LOI :thumbsup:
Mia Chen: approved contingent on LOI and Jordan's rollout doc. thanks everyone — this preserves primary OKR with minimal knock-on effects.
Alex Nguyen: filing an OKR reforecast now and tagging eng/product leads. will update roadmap gantt and PRD.
Priya Rao: noted — I'll update the revenue forecast model once LOI arrives.
Jordan Patel: uploading initial runbook to #docs: `s3://redwood-plans/latency-mvp/runbook-v1.md`
Alex Nguyen: great. closing this thread after LOI and rollout doc land. thanks all.
